# Module `prelude`

prelude - a shared re-export surface for the core contracts.

The compiler auto-imports the core aspects into every module unless a module
imports the contracts itself or locally redefines one of them (see
`core::aspects`). `prelude` collects that default surface in one place: the
canonical core aspects plus `prelude_ok`, so tooling and modules can treat
"the built-in contracts" as a single importable namespace.

The definitions live in `core::aspects` / `core::prelude`; this module is a
convenience facade rather than a second home for the symbols.
